name: diderm flagellar apparatus
description: The flagellum of a Gram-negative style envelope, in which the rod passes through P- and L-ring bushings.

name: monoderm flagellar apparatus
description: The flagellum of a single-membrane envelope, which is built without L and P rings. It is a distinct architecture rather than the diderm architecture with an optional part, because the bushings are absent by construction and not merely unannotated.

name: type IVa pilus machinery
description: The conserved type IVa pilus machine: prepilin processing, a major pilin, an extension ATPase, the inner membrane platform, the alignment subcomplex and the outer membrane secretin, with retraction as an accessory function.

name: canonical LptA--G apparatus
description: The seven-component trans-envelope Lpt machine, represented as an inner-membrane extractor, a periplasmic bridge and an outer-membrane translocon.

name: Staphylococcus-type poly(ribitol-phosphate) WTA
description: Complete ribitol-phosphate WTA construction using the Staphylococcus TarF glycerol-phosphate primase and bifunctional TarL ribitol-phosphate primase/polymerase, together with the shared linkage, donor, export and attachment functions.

name: W23-type poly(ribitol-phosphate) WTA
description: Complete ribitol-phosphate WTA construction using the Bacillus subtilis W23 TarK ribitol-phosphate primase and TarL elongating polymerase, together with the shared linkage, donor, export and attachment functions.

name: diglucosyldiacylglycerol-anchored poly(glycerol-phosphate) LTA
description: The three-function architecture in which YpfP/UgtP-family synthesis supplies the diglucosyldiacylglycerol anchor, LtaA presents it at the outer leaflet of the cytoplasmic membrane and LtaS polymerizes the glycerol-phosphate chain.
